newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BS Continental begun as mkt perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BS Continental begun as mkt perform.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said it has initiated coverage of Brazilian white goods manufacturer BS Continental as with a market perform rating.
-- The investment bank also said in a report that it expects the company will post earnings of $2.12 per 1,000 shares in 1996, $2.74 in 1997 and $3.15 in 1998.
-- It has set a 12-to-18-month price target for BS Continental of $25.25 per lot of 1,000 shares, up 10 percent from current levels.
-- BS Continental is Brazil's second-largest stove maker and the stove market is poised to grow 7.5 percent in 1997 and five percent in 1998, the bank said.
-- BS Continental's preferred share was up 0.11 reais at 23.51 reais at 1641 local/1341 EDT on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
